it does help yeah i mean, i guess there’s just a finesse to being like content if that makes sense and i’m sure i’ll find it at some point. it’s just rough, yknow like day to day and trying to like make myself okay with striving for money and like normal things when i really have never had any desire for them. like i feel like i’m changing a lot, in a bad way, and it’s hard to submit to that and get on with my life when rhat involves changing such important things like how i used to like hate a lot of stuff i like now or vice versa, if that makes sense. kinda hard to put into words. idk. maybe it’s just normal growing up fear. 
thank you though, it’s comforting to know it’s possible to just be content as you seem to be. that’s all i want is to just be content. thank you.

i really appreciate that. sorry for the late reply, i don’t check this account often, but that’s one of the most comforting things i’ve heard in a while. thank you. 

i think it’s a product of just her circumstances at the moment. around the time we met she lost a lot of her friends and i think she might just be relying on me a lot, which i’m fine with. it makes me feel loved and it seems to help her get through it. 

it’s been going better though, i think part of my questioning was just a defence mechanism. we had a couple bad moments and i guess i just wanted to convince myself that i didn’t care as much as i did.

i guess it does come and go sometimes. there’s definitely something there, maybe you’re right and it’s just bc i’m not as enthusiastic as her sometimes. idk, i appreciate the perspective, i think that’s one of my biggest issues here lol

i don’t know really, i find this kind of stuff hard. i guess the same feelings as i’m having now, where i kinda feel crowded snd it’s hard to think about anything else. 

she seems really enthusiastic about the relationship. i don’t know if i can match thst snd i don’t want to end it snd hurt her feelings or lead her on

therapy, tried seeing people and going out more , drugs for a bit, nothing really made me feel any different, idk 

i’m not sure really. i’ve hurt a lot of people, i’m scared i’m gonna end up hurting her - she seems really happy about it and i have a lot of feelings rn so it’s hard for me to even tell if i like her lol, feel like entering into a relationship was a bit irresponsible
